1018-4875-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
1018-4875-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Conspiracy, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Skullwinder token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-789-2466-3249--52.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Gutter Grime triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

240-1879-4247-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

5170-6132-6798-7918.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1003-3652-5049-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1003-3652-5049-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

360-4186-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
360-4186-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-5056-7704.description:
Cause Doc Samson to become an artifact using Neurok Transmuter.
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Doc Samson.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more loyalty counters on it

598-2452-2974.description:
Activate Liliana's third ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie cards from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Repository Skaab either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {0}.
When Repository Skaab enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
Repository Skaab triggers, returning an instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

643-5256-5659-6483.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dark Revenant.
When Dark Revenant dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to Dark Revenant's power, which will cause you to mill Dark Revenant.
As Dark Revenant is a Lhurgoyf due to Maskwood Nexus, Disa's first ability triggers, returning Dark Revenant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2510-4907-5231-6989.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact and/or creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.

2724-3080-5299-7309.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
At the beginning of your end step, Don & Leo triggers, blinking Exchange of Words.
Exchange of Words leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering the second ability it gained from Wormfang Manta's textbox as well as its own ability.
Resolve the first Exchange of Words trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the second Exchange of Words trigger, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 during each turn.

628-5256-7213.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Encumbered Reejerey.
When Encumbered Reejerey dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.

586-5147-5258-5618-7183.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2281-3817-5147.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

147-554-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-554-5231.description:
Cast Extract from Darkness by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Extract from Darkness.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Extract from Darkness
Resolve the Extract from Darkness copy, causing each player to mill two cards and returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

413-2018-5263.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a flying counter on it.
When Optimus Prime, Hero enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve both Blasting Station abilities from steps 1 and 4, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.

24-1640-3799.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, choosing an arbitrarily large number and having Wheel of Misfortune deal that much damage to Stuffy Doll instead of you due to Pariah's Shield if you chose the largest number.
Stuffy Doll triggers, dealing that much damage to the named player.
24-1640-3799.notes: If you didn't choose the highest number, Wheel of Misfortune will deal damage to the opponent(s) who did equal to that number.

628-2921-5405.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Soulstinger.
When Soulstinger dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Soulstinger enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

526-2781-4615.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one nontoken creature with base power 4 or greater.
526-2781-4615.description:
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying {1}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Felidar Guardian.
When the Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking any creature you control with base power 4 or greater.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Life Finds A Way triggers, creating a token copy of the Felidar Guardian token.
Repeat from step 2.

3259-3973-4068-4214.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four permanents of any color on the battlefield.
Breath of Fury attached to any creature you control except Rith.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
3259-3973-4068-4214.description:
Deal combat damage using Rith and the creature with Breath of Fury attached, triggering Rith and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Rith trigger, causing you to pay {2}{G} to create at least four 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Saproling token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, and deal combat damage using Rith and the creature with Breath of Fury attached, triggering Rith and Breath of Fury.
Holding priority, activate Utopia Mycon's second ability three times by sacrificing three Saprolings, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

719-859-2569-4289.notablePrerequisites:
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
"Merfolk" chosen with Xenograft.
719-859-2569-4289.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

2517-4681-5256-5276.notablePrerequisites: Parallax Wave has at least one fade counter on it.
2517-4681-5256-5276.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Parallax Wave by removing a fade counter from it, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Leonin Relic-Warder trigger, exiling Parallax Wave.
When Parallax Wave leaves the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Parallax Wave from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Leonin Relic-Warder's power.
Resolve the Parallax Wave trigger from step 5, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

567-2034-2919-3490.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
567-2034-2919-3490.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve all but one Animation Module trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the last Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Soul's Attendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

1496-3263-4078-4242-5231.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
1496-3263-4078-4242-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {R}.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Chainer by paying {3} and 3 life, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Su-Chi enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Su-Chi's toughness.
Repeat.

1981-1984-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1981-1984-5147.description:
Cast Angel's Grace by paying {W}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature, dealing 1 damage to you, with your life total becoming no lower than 1 due to Angel's Grace.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

2249-2762-4659.notablePrerequisites: Thopter Squadron has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
2249-2762-4659.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan ironworks by sacrificing the Thopter, adding {C}{C}.
When the Thopter dies, Death's Presence triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Thopter Squadron.
Repeat.

1020-2438-3451-4766.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or greater.
1020-2438-3451-4766.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Myr Retriever.
When Myr Retriever dies, it, Deathrender and Death's Oasis triggers.
Resolve the Myr Retriever trigger, returning an artifact creature card with mana value three or greater from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the artifact creature with mana value three or greater from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Death's Oasis trigger, causing you to mill two cards and return a creature card with mana value one or less from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature with Deathrender attached.
When the creature dies, Deathrender and Death's Oasis triggers.
Resolve the Death's Oasis trigger, causing you to mill two cards and return Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Myr Retriever from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve both Carrion Feeder abilities from steps 1 and 6, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

121-1371-1827-3765.description:
Cast Vampiric Tutor by paying {B}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to create a copy of Vampiric Tutor.
Holding priority, cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to create a copy of Worldfire.
Resolve each Worldfire on the stack, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to one.
Resolve the first opponent's copy of Vampiric Tutor, causing them to search their library for a card, put it on top of their library and lose 2 life.
The opponent loses the game due to having less than zero life.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining opponent.

1560-2290-2510-4638.notablePrerequisites:
An enchantment exiled by Semblance Anvil.
You have at least 3 life.
1560-2290-2510-4638.description:
Pay 2 life to cast Broken Fall.
Defiler of Vigor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Spike Feeder to activate it, gaining 2 life.
Resolve Broken Fall.
Return Broken Fall to your hand to activate it, regenerating any target creature.
Repeat.
